children: South Korea’s Composite Consumer Sentiment Index (CCSI) rose 2.1 points to 106.6 in September 2026 from August. Consumer sentiment regarding current living standards was unchanged at 92, while sentiment about the future outlook rose one point to 98.
Sentiment regarding future household income increased two points to 102, while that concerning future household spending rose one point to 110.
Consumer sentiment about current domestic economic conditions climbed four points to 83, while sentiment regarding future domestic economic conditions rose one point to 90.
Sentiment on prospective employment opportunities increased two points to 88, while expectations for interest rates rose three points to 128.
Expected inflation over the next year was unchanged at 2.7%, while three- and five-year inflation expectations both remained at 2.6%.

title: South Korea Consumer Sentiment Recovers in September
